p:
Name of work: - Construction of Single-story Building for NCERT with Septic Tank including Electrical Work at CW Maligaon, (ASSAM)
As per the work order stipulated date of Completion was 14.05.2023 and actual date of Completion is 15.02.2024 i.e., total of 277 days of delay. As per EOT Application submitted by the contractor, total of 300 days of hindrance has been requested.
Contractor has applied for EOT stating site was not clear for construction as RailTel Pipes were kept at the site which was removed on 26.04.2023 and accordingly work stated on 05.05.2023, total of 143 days. Time extension 26.04.2023 is justified for the above reason total to 134 days.
GMDA Approval came on 28th March 2023. This delay is also justified as statutory bodies approval is must. Delay of 105 days is overlapping with the above hindrance, As the hindrance has been given for this period in above case hence, 0-day hindrance is given for the hindrance.
Contractor has applied for hindrance due to rainfall which effected the work at site, total of 19 days which is also justified considering the intensity of rainfall and working condition and nature of workers in northeast region. The overlap of 3 days is there in the month of July and hence 16 days delay is justified.
Contractor has applied for hindrance due to vetting of the structural drawing from Assam Engineering college, the drawing has changed by AEC and hindrance from 26.04.2023 till 10.07.2023, total to 75 days. Work at site cannot be started before vetted drawing received from government engineering college. Considering the above fact the 75 days delay is justified.
Contractor has applied for hindrance due to traffic restriction at maligoan area considering construction of Fly over. As no entry was applied hindrance occurred for movement of materials, machinery and manpower at the site. The Hindrance was removed in the month of 31.10.2023 since start of the work at the site. Hindrance of 15 days has been applied by the contractor since 10.07.2023. 15 % approx. hindrance requested and justified, 15 days hindrance for the case.
Contractor has applied for 34 days of delay due to non-availability of the colour scheme from 24.11.2023 till 02.01.2024. Approx 80% of the work was completed till 24.11.2023. Colour code was finalised by the corporate office on 13.01.2024. Considering the volume of work left in the work. 30 % of hindrance from 24.11.2023 till 13.01.2024 is justified. 15.30 days of hindrance for colour scheme case.
Contractor has applied for 7 days of delay due to decision and changes which were done by NCERT (depositor), 4 days delay due to change of scope of work MS door to Panel door. 9 days of Hindrance due to processing of bill at regional office. Total of 20 days of hindrance requested by the contractor. The hindrance in the work is observed due to above reason and justified delay of 20 days.
Extra item executed by the contractor at the site amounting Rs. 1.60 lakhs approx., the time allowed for completion of the extra item work is 4 days.
From the above deliberation and explanation of the delay in the work, total justified delay for the work is 275.30 days and extra item executed by the contractor for which 4 days must be given extra for execution of the extra item work which was required for completion of the work. Total of 279.30 days of Hindrance + extra time is consumed. Contractor has applied for 300 days of hindrance which is being supported by the correspondence letter/documents. As per the hindrance register 291.69 day of hindrance is recorded at the site for the work. For the completion of the work at the site delay of 277 days has occurred against justified delay of 279.30 days. Hence, the EOT till 15.02.2024 is recommended for approval without levy of LD to the contractor for the work of Construction of Single story Building for NCERT with Septic Tank including Electrical Work at CW Maligaon, (ASSAM).
